title: MONDAY LEGS AND LUNGS
subtitle: MONDAY. LEGS AND LUNGS. SQUAT, STEP, LUNGE, CLIMB. OWN THE BALANCE. OPEN THE HIPS AND INNER THIGHS TO FINISH. FEEL IT. DO NOT BE SORE TOMORROW.

script.welcome: ON YOUR FEET. MONDAY. LEGS AND LUNGS. SEVENTEEN MINUTES. SQUAT, STEP, LUNGE, CLIMB. THEN BALANCE AND A PROPER HIP OPENER. THE WEEKEND IS OVER, YOU IDLE SOD. GET OUT OF THAT CHAIR.
script.start: CLOCK IS LIVE. MOVE YOUR ARSE.
script.rest: REST. BREATHE. DO NOT DRAPE YOURSELF OVER THE BLOODY BANISTER.
script.lastSet: LAST ROUND. FINISH CLEAN. I'M WATCHING.
script.complete: DISMISSED. LEGS WORKED. LUNGS OPENED. HIPS LOOSE. BALANCE OWNED. NOW GO AND HAVE A MONDAY WITHOUT WALKING LIKE A BLOODY ARTHRITIC PENGUIN.
script.pause: HOLD. CLOCK STOPPED. DO NOT GET COMFY.

exercises.name: CHAIR SQUAT
exercises.cue: STAND IN FRONT OF A STURDY CHAIR. FEET HIP-WIDTH. SIT BACK UNTIL YOUR BACKSIDE BRUSHES THE SEAT, THEN DRIVE UP THROUGH THE HEELS. CHEST UP. KNEES TRACK OVER TOES. CONTROL THE WAY DOWN.
exercises.speakStart: CHAIR SQUATS. TWO SETS. TEN REPS. SIT BACK. KISS THE SEAT WITH YOUR BACKSIDE. DRIVE UP THROUGH THE HEELS. DO NOT PLONK DOWN LIKE YOU ARE SETTLING IN FOR THE BLOODY SNOOKER.

exercises.name: STAIR STEP-UP
exercises.cue: BOTTOM STAIR. HAND ON THE RAIL IF YOU WANT IT. WHOLE FOOT ON THE STEP. PUSH THROUGH THE HEEL AND STAND TALL AT THE TOP. STEP DOWN SLOW. EIGHT ON ONE LEG, THEN SWITCH.
exercises.speakStart: STEP UPS. TWO SETS. EIGHT EACH LEG. BOTTOM STAIR. WHOLE FOOT ON THE STEP. STAND TALL AT THE TOP. STEP DOWN SLOW. DO NOT CLUMP ABOUT LIKE A BLOODY CART HORSE.

exercises.name: CHAIR-ASSISTED REVERSE LUNGE
exercises.cue: LIGHT HAND ON A CHAIR BACK. STEP ONE FOOT BACK AND LOWER UNTIL BOTH KNEES ARE SOFTLY BENT. SHORT RANGE IS LEGAL. FRONT HEEL DOWN. PUSH BACK UP THROUGH THE FRONT LEG. SWITCH LEGS.
exercises.speakStart: REVERSE LUNGES. TWO SETS. SIX EACH LEG. HAND ON THE CHAIR. STEP BACK. LOWER WITH CONTROL. DRIVE UP THROUGH THE FRONT HEEL. SHORT RANGE IS FINE. SLOPPY RANGE IS NOT.

exercises.name: STAIR MOUNTAIN CLIMBERS
exercises.cue: HANDS ON THE FIFTH STAIR. BODY IN A LONG LINE. DRIVE ONE KNEE TOWARD THE STEP, THEN THE OTHER. STEADY RHYTHM, NOT A SPRINT. BREATHE. THIS IS YOUR LUNGS WORK.
exercises.speakStart: STAIR MOUNTAIN CLIMBERS. TWO ROUNDS. TWENTY SECONDS. HANDS ON THE FIFTH STEP. KNEES DRIVE IN. STEADY RHYTHM. THIS IS YOUR LUNGS WORK. DO NOT FLAIL LIKE A BLOODY WINDMILL IN A GALE.
exercises.speakRest: THIRTY. GET YOUR BREATH BACK. I'M WATCHING.

exercises.name: SINGLE-LEG STAND WITH KNEE LIFT
exercises.cue: STAND TALL BESIDE A CHAIR. LIFT ONE KNEE TO HIP HEIGHT AND HOLD. SOFT KNEE ON THE STANDING LEG. FINGERTIPS ON THE CHAIR ONLY IF YOU NEED THEM. EYES ON ONE SPOT. THIS IS YOUR BALANCE WORK.
exercises.speakStart: SINGLE LEG STANDS WITH A KNEE LIFT. TWO ROUNDS. TWENTY SECONDS EACH LEG. KNEE UP TO HIP HEIGHT. EYES ON ONE SPOT. THIS IS YOUR BALANCE WORK. DO NOT WOBBLE LIKE A BLOODY FLAMINGO ON ITS THIRD PINT.
exercises.speakRest: TWENTY. SWITCH LEGS. EYES ON YOU.

exercises.name: LOW-LUNGE HIP OPENER
exercises.cue: LONG SPLIT STANCE OR HALF-KNEELING WITH A CUSHION UNDER THE BACK KNEE. HANDS ON THE FRONT THIGH OR A CHAIR. TUCK THE TAIL SLIGHTLY AND EASE THE HIPS FORWARD. FEEL THE FRONT OF THE BACK HIP. ARMS OVERHEAD FOR THE LAST FEW BREATHS IF IT FEELS GOOD. NO YANKING.
exercises.speakStart: LOW LUNGE HIP OPENERS. TWO ROUNDS. THIRTY SECONDS EACH SIDE. LONG STANCE. TUCK THE TAIL. EASE FORWARD. THIS IS YOUR HIP OPENER, UNDOING A WEEKEND OF SITTING. DO NOT FORCE IT LIKE YOU ARE SHOULDERING A BLOODY PUB DOOR.

exercises.name: WIDE-STANCE SIDE-SHIFT STRETCH
exercises.cue: FEET WIDE, TOES SLIGHTLY OUT. SLOWLY SHIFT YOUR WEIGHT TO ONE SIDE, BENDING THAT KNEE, OTHER LEG LONG. FEEL THE INNER THIGH. PAUSE, THEN SHIFT ACROSS. HANDS ON THIGHS OR A CHAIR. SLOW AND SMOOTH. INNER-THIGH OPENER.
exercises.speakStart: WIDE STANCE SIDE SHIFTS. TWO ROUNDS. THIRTY SECONDS. FEET WIDE. SHIFT SLOW TO ONE SIDE. FEEL THE INNER THIGH. PAUSE. SHIFT ACROSS. THIS IS YOUR STRETCH WORK. DO NOT LUNGE ABOUT LIKE A BLOODY SUMO WRESTLER LOOKING FOR HIS LUNCH.
exercises.speakRest: FIFTEEN. LAST ONE COMING. I'M WATCHING.
exercises.speakDone: SIDE SHIFTS DONE. THAT IS THE LOT.
